title: BuildIt esbuild Configuration
description: Official JSON Schema configuration for BuildIt esbuild orchestrator.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for autocomplete and validation in editors.

defineVersionString.description: Identifier of the constant for application version injection (default: '__APP_VERSION__').

versionPaths.description: List of files or directories where the synchronized version.ts should be ensured.

forcepackagesversion.description: If true, synchronizes the version across all workspace packages (deno.json / deno.jsonc).

default.description: If true, executed automatically when no specific target is passed to CLI.

distdir.description: Final output directory where compiled artifacts are written.

copyFiles.description: Sets of copy rules for static files to distdir.

includes.description: List of glob / brace expansion patterns to include.

excludes.description: List of glob / brace expansion patterns to exclude.

includes.description: Glob patterns relative to distdir to remove (use '*' for everything).

excludes.description: Glob patterns relative to distdir to preserve.

oneOf.description: List of paths to clean before build (relative to distdir, use '*' to empty distdir).

clean.description: Pre-build cleanup rules for output directory.

entryPoints.description: Entry files to compile (relative to srcdir).

platform.description: Target runtime execution platform for the generated bundle.

bundle.description: Whether to bundle external dependencies and imports into consolidated files.

minify.description: Whether to apply full minification of identifiers, syntax, and whitespace.

conditions.description: Custom conditions for package.json export resolution.

define.description: Map of global compile-time constants for replacement.

defineAssetsString.description: Identifier of the constant for injecting the list of generated assets (e.g., '__GENERATED_ASSETS__').

drop.description: Directives to eliminate calls from compiled code.

external.description: Modules or packages to treat as external and avoid bundling.

metafile.description: If true, generates a metafile.json containing dependency graph and size metrics.

write.description: If true, writes output to disk.

treeShaking.description: Whether dead code elimination is enabled. Accepts 'ignore' to explicitly disable.

analyze.description: Generates bundle analysis report in console after build (enables metafile automatically).

reserveProps.description: Regex for properties to preserve during mangling (e.g., '/^_.*/').

sideEffects.description: Informs esbuild whether code should be treated as having side effects for tree-shaking.

legalComments.description: Preservation and positioning of license and copyright comments.

keepNames.description: Preserves original function and class names even when minified.

outfile.description: Consolidated output file path (relative to distdir when provided).

splitting.description: Enables code splitting for dynamic loading in ESM.

inject.description: Files to inject at the top of bundle before entry points.

banner.description: Comments or code snippets added to top of generated file. Supports __APP_VERSION__.

footer.description: Comments or code snippets added to bottom of generated file. Supports __APP_VERSION__.

charset.description: Character set encoding for generated files.

logLevel.description: Detail level for esbuild console logs.

logOverride.description: Log level override by message identifier.

entryNames.description: Naming pattern for entry point files.

publicPath.description: Base public path for loading chunks and assets.

pure.description: Identifiers treated as pure for dead code elimination (e.g., ['console.log']).

globalName.description: Global variable name for exposing IIFE bundle.

tsconfig.description: Path to a custom TypeScript configuration file (tsconfig.json).

tsconfigRaw.description: Raw TypeScript configuration content (JSON string or object).

sourcesContent.description: Whether to include original source file content in sourcemaps.

ignoreAnnotations.description: Whether to ignore purity annotations like /* @__PURE__ */ during minification.

minifyIdentifiers.description: Granular minification: rename identifiers to short names.

minifySyntax.description: Granular minification: rewrite syntax to more compact forms.

mangleQuoted.description: Whether to mangle quoted object properties.

mangleCache.description: Cache for persisting mangled names across builds.
